field_evidence.dataset_title: Assessment of Local Risks supporting the London Safety Plan 2017
field_evidence.dataset_statement: The official London Datastore page publishes ward-level data for the 2017 Assessment of Local Risks in CSV and XLS formats; the data underpins an LFB postcode look-up tool.

records.evidence_slice: London Datastore publishes the official London Fire Brigade 'Assessment of Local Risks supporting the London Safety Plan 2017' dataset and explicitly states that ward-level data is available in CSV and XLS formats. This batch binds the verified Campden ward identity (E05009390) to that unused ward-data source window. The direct CSV fetch was unavailable through the current web transport, so no Campden metric values, geometry, parcel join or parcel progress are claimed.
